stages.name: Question
stages.zh: 夹爪开合与横向移动，如何改变物体状态？
stages.en: How do gripper opening and position affect the object?

stages.name: Observational graph
stages.zh: 从 256 张观测图像得到候选图；虚线保留方向不确定性。
stages.en: 256 observation images produce this candidate graph; dashed directions remain open.

stages.name: Select 1
stages.zh: 操作 1：改变夹爪开合，观察是否带动物体升高。
stages.en: Operation 1: change the opening; observe the object height.

stages.name: initial
stages.zh: 操作 1：改变夹爪开合，观察是否带动物体升高。
stages.en: Operation 1: change the opening; observe the object height.

stages.name: Update 1
stages.zh: 整批证据新增：夹爪间距 → 物体高度。
stages.en: Batch evidence adds: opening → object height.

stages.name: lower_after_measurement
stages.zh: 测量已结束；放下物体并撤回机械臂。
stages.en: Measurement complete; put down the object and retreat.

stages.name: Reset
stages.zh: 重置为下一次独立操作的初态。
stages.en: Reset to the initial state of the next independent trial.

stages.name: Select 2
stages.zh: 操作 2：改变夹爪横向位置，观察物体位置。
stages.en: Operation 2: change gripper position; observe object position.

stages.name: initial
stages.zh: 操作 2：改变夹爪横向位置，观察物体位置。
stages.en: Operation 2: change gripper position; observe object position.

stages.name: Update 2
stages.zh: 第二轮没有新增方向；保留原图，不强行补边。
stages.en: Round 2 adds no direction; retain the graph without inventing edges.

stages.name: lower_after_measurement
stages.zh: 测量已结束；放下物体并撤回机械臂。
stages.en: Measurement complete; put down the object and retreat.

stages.name: Result
stages.zh: 学到 3 条方向，目标—匹配仍未定向；不等于完整真图。
stages.en: Three directed edges; target—alignment remains open. This is not complete recovery.

scope: Recorded graph-discovery illustration, not evidence for calibration benefits or complete causal identification.
presentation: Recomposited original robot frames; fixed cameras; bilingual captions; graph states from discovery logs. Static cards and explicit resets added. Timing follows original replay frame cadence, not a real-time physics claim.
